goal: Establish a deterministic, evidence-closed Wiki formation layer that cannot read evaluation questions or Gold before consuming a new held-out Stage A.
allowedFormationInputs: resolvable SourceSpan text and document structure
forbiddenFormationInputs: manual Claim bundles selected for a known evaluation question

v1Boundary.formationSignal: Nearest structural Markdown heading plus bounded evidence position within one Source.
v1Boundary.consumerAlignment: A module must fit the online atomic-injection contract: ten primary slots, three protected lexical seeds, and at least one seed already contained in the module.
v1Boundary.relationRole: Current audited Relations may be recorded as dependencies but cannot merge unrelated structural sections.

gates.pass: Formation API has no task, question or Gold parameter; the frozen run input manifest contains no evaluation path.
Repeated runs and reversed input order produce byte-identical seeds and stableAddress values.
Every formed assertion materializes to one canonical active Claim and all of its Evidence resolves; invalid claims are rejected with reason codes.
Module size and evidence cost are bounded; no domain-, question- or Gold-specific production branch exists.
Only after formation artifacts are frozen may a separate Dev evaluator inspect known questions to diagnose formation recall. That diagnostic cannot rewrite the first artifact.

stopRules: Do not request a new held-out Stage A until H1A-G0 through G3 pass on revealed multi-domain Dev data.
Do not claim automatic cross-source synthesis from same-section grouping.
Do not tune formation with revealed question IDs or Gold strings.
